summary.text: Tom Oliver, listed by Ballotpedia as Thomas Oliver, is a Republican state representative from Franklin-4 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has a background in law enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Tom Oliver was born in Amarillo, Texas, moved to Burlington, Vermont, when he was eight, and lives in Sheldon, Vermont.
He graduated from Burlington High School and earned a bachelor's degree in social sciences from Champlain College.

His career experience includes working in law enforcement for the Franklin County Sheriff's Department and as a state deputy sheriff in Burlington, and he volunteered for Amcare Ambulance and was a justice of the peace in Sheldon.
Oliver assumed office on January 4, 2023, succeeding Robert Norris, and advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
He served on the House Judiciary Committee and the Judicial Retention Committee in 2023-2024.
